corrections_or_clarifications.verified_scope: Current author materials report KSI means over three seeds, while DGM/HyperAgents baselines are single reruns under the KSI evaluation protocol. There is no significance test establishing superiority for every reported cell. Preserve this asymmetry when assigning evidence strength.

The primary materials support that the whole KSI protocol improves cumulative solve rate under its setup and that knowledge is the only persistent object. They do not, by the claims verified here, isolate forum discussion, cross-task discussion, distillation, raw attempt storage, and adapter/routing as separate causal components. Do not infer that 'curation beats storage' without a dedicated ablation.
The headline solve rates are cumulative across a 10-generation fixed task pool with solved tasks retired, not ordinary single-pass benchmark pass@1. Compare only under matched protocol/budget.

A separate anonymous/under-review project mirror currently exposes materially different headline values (for example Haiku 4.5 ARC-AGI-1 82%, Polyglot 80%, SWE-bench Pro 84%, Terminal-Bench 2 47.2%) than the current named author page (86.7±4.2, 68.0±2.0, 64.0±2.0, Terminal-Bench 2 43.8±3.4). Treat these as different/stale public versions, not interchangeable evidence. Downstream artifacts must bind numbers to the exact source/version or date.
